verdict.rationale: Docs reference an OpenAPI specification used to generate client libraries (yapily-docs-8), implying a machine-readable spec exists, but a direct probe for standard OpenAPI/Swagger file locations returned 404 everywhere (yapily-probe-2), meaning no publicly downloadable spec could be located. missing for 10: a working public URL/download link for the OpenAPI/Swagger file, confirmation of its format and completeness, and independent corroboration that it can actually be fetched.
